summary_short.zh: AiToEarn 是一个开源 Electron 桌面应用，旨在通过 AI 自动发布内容到抖音、快手、小红书等中文社交平台，解决创作者在多平台重复发布内容的痛点。其技术亮点在于使用 React 构建前端界面，并通过封装各平台 API 实现一键自动发布，同时预留了 AI 内容生成接口，可集成大模型优化文案或生成素材。你可以通过添加新的平台适配器来扩展支持范围，或接入自定义 AI 模型实现个性化内容创作。适合需要高效管理多账号、提升内容分发效率的社交媒体运营者或独立创作者。

summaries.en: AiToEarn is an open-source Electron app that automates content publishing to Chinese social platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, and Xiaohongshu. It uses AI to generate or optimize posts, saving creators time on repetitive tasks. Technically, it combines a React frontend with platform-specific APIs for seamless auto-publishing. You can extend it by adding new platform adapters or integrating custom AI models for content creation. Ideal for social media managers or indie creators looking to scale their output efficiently.

summary_short.zh: react-doctor 是一个专门检测 React 代码问题的工具，尤其擅长捕捉 AI 代理或开发者编写的低质量组件。它通过静态分析和规则检查，识别常见反模式，如缺失 key、无效重渲染或 Hook 使用错误。你可以将其集成到 CI/CD 流程中，或在本地运行，在合并前审查 AI 生成的 React 代码，确保生产质量。这个工具的核心价值在于填补了 AI 代码审查的空白，让团队放心使用 AI 辅助开发。试试用它检查你的 AI 助手写的 React 组件吧。
summary_short.en: react-doctor is a tool that catches bad React code written by AI agents or humans, solving the problem of low-quality generated components. It uses static analysis and rule-based checks to identify anti-patterns like missing keys, inefficient re-renders, or incorrect hooks usage…

summaries.en: react-doctor is a tool that catches bad React code written by AI agents or humans, solving the problem of low-quality generated components. It uses static analysis and rule-based checks to identify anti-patterns like missing keys, inefficient re-renders, or incorrect hooks usage. You can integrate it into your CI/CD pipeline or run it locally to review AI-generated React code before merging, ensuring production-ready quality.

summary_short.zh: OpenHuman 是一个用 Rust 构建的个人 AI 超级智能助手，主打隐私、简单和强大。它完全在本地运行，无需云端服务，确保数据安全。其核心优势在于将本地大模型推理与工具调用能力结合，支持网页搜索、文件管理、代码执行等操作。开发者可通过插件扩展功能，或将其集成到工作流中作为安全的离线 AI 副驾驶。适合注重隐私且需要多功能自托管 AI 的用户。

summaries.en: OpenHuman is a private, simple, and powerful personal AI assistant built in Rust. It prioritizes user privacy by running entirely locally, eliminating cloud dependencies. Its key strength is combining local LLM inference with tool-use capabilities for tasks like web search, file management, and code execution. Developers can extend it via plugins or integrate it into their workflows as a secure, offline AI copilot. Ideal for privacy-conscious users needing a versatile, self-hosted AI.
